title: VCMI Game Transcript version 4
description: Schema for a VGT 4 YAML multi-document stream after parsing it into an array: the header is element zero and every later element is a turn or world document. Descriptions are the machine-readable documentation for fields and variants.

identifier.description: A compact reversible VGT identifier. The core namespace is implicit; hero/ and object/ are not format prefixes; located objects end in @x.y on the surface or @x.y.z on another level.

actor.description: The player, AI, world, neutral AI, or timer that chose an action.

playerColor.description: A VCMI player color or a special owner value such as neutral, unflaggable, or cannotDetermine.

position.description: Canonical adventure-map position. [x,y] means the surface (z=0); the three-item form is reserved for a nonzero level.

resourceValues.description: Sparse resource mapping. Positive/negative values are deltas when the enclosing verb denotes a change; set* verbs contain absolute values.

strategicArmyStack.description: Absolute strategic stack. Nonzero experience is explicit; absent experience means zero.

playerSettings.description: Sparse lobby settings for one player slot. A resolved player always supplies controller and faction; an initialPlayers entry is a delta from it.

initialPlayerRoster.description: Only fields that differ from the corresponding resolved players entry. Empty means no setup delta.

mapGenerator.description: Random-map inputs as a delta from resolved transcript defaults: one level, no teams or computer-only slots, no water, normal monsters, no roads, and sequential AI/random players with one team per color. slots preserves otherwise-default inactive colors when present.

slots.description: Present color slots when they differ from the sequential active-player default.

header.description: The first YAML document. It contains everything needed to initialize deterministic replay from the referenced map.

id.description: Stable short identifier derived from immutable game initialization data.

partial.description: Operational marker for history captured after loading a save whose earlier transcript could not be found. Partial transcripts validate but cannot replay until repaired.

uri.description: Map resource URI or path used by replay.

textEncoding.description: How source map text was decoded before UTF-8 transcript storage. h3m-auto accepts authored UTF-8 and otherwise uses the named legacy fallback.

objectNameCounter.description: Initial unique object-name counter, needed for deterministic runtime object aliases.

startTime.description: Recorded initialization timestamp. It is input data, not the transcript wall-clock time.

gameSettingsOverrides.description: Open game-setting override tree; its keys are defined by the active ruleset and mods.

calendarDate.description: Calendar date as month/week/day-of-week; day zero is emitted as numeric zero.

phase.description: A startup chapter or the single global chapter applied before all players on a new day.

actor.description: Omitted when it is the player named by the turn document.

directionSteps.description: Space-separated compass directions; a *N suffix repeats the preceding direction N times.

discoveryList.description: Strategically notable objects first revealed to the acting player's team by this movement. Replay derives visibility normally and warns when this list differs from engine-derived first sightings; it never applies visibility from the list.

movementBody.description: One tile uses only to; every multi-tile ordinary move uses to plus direction runs. Coordinate route lists are not part of VGT 4.

moveAction.description: One uninterrupted ordinary hero movement decision. Gates, teleports, embark/disembark, blocking visits, and level changes are separate semantic actions.

townBuildingAction.description: Builds, visits, or razes one named structure in a town; the enclosing record key selects the operation. An explicit hero on visitTownBuilding records consumption of an automatic per-hero or weekly town reward such as a Mana Vortex.

buildAction.description: One construction transaction. Cost is retained for readability and auditing; automatically granted derivative buildings are regenerated and are not listed.

pool.description: Named availability pool, only when the same creature can be bought from multiple pools at this source.

recruitAction.description: One purchase or an ordered batch of consecutive purchases at the same source. paid is retained as a readable audit result; the resulting pool is regenerated.

value.description: Raw server answer retained for exact replay.

approach.description: Exact uninterrupted ordinary movement immediately leading to this event.

questRequest.description: A quest requirement learned in this encounter. A single requested artifact is scalar; multiple artifacts form a list.

text.description: Only genuine map-authored narrative or decision-bearing custom text.

encounterAction.description: A visit together with its optional prompt answer and ordered semantic results. An encounter without choice records a non-interactive visit result.

hireAction.description: Hero recruitment with deterministic cost folded in. Exceptional replacement, arrival, and boat data are present only when meaningful.

name.description: Readable meaning of a decision-bearing reply when its parent action cannot carry a dedicated choice field.

refreshUndeadMorale.description: Rare replay detail: armies whose undead morale modifier was removed and recreated during the arrangement. This preserves byte-identical internal bonus order without exposing low-level stack moves.

arrangeArmiesAction.description: Absolute final armies after one uninterrupted arrangement session. This replaces low-level swaps, merges, and one-creature splits with the strategically meaningful result.

moveArtifactsAction.description: Consecutive artifact transfers between the same holders. Artifact names are human-readable; exact source and destination slots preserve replay order.

singleResourceAmount.description: One named resource and its nonnegative amount.

tradeAction.description: Adjacent resource-for-resource exchanges at one market. Each natural-language item freezes both named amounts, for example '5 ore for 100 gold'; repeated pairs are aggregated.

activity.description: Semantic UI activity made available by an encounter, such as market, shipyard, exchange, or garrison.

captureRecord.description: A capture and its semantic ownership/income outcome. hero and approach identify a player action; they are omitted when the enclosing scene or effect context already supplies them.

battleUnitName.description: Stable battle-local side/creature name, with a final ordinal segment when needed. Raw stack numbers are confined to the roster.

acceptedAs.description: Exceptional accepted action when the server transformed the request.

gate.description: A siege gate state change folded into the uninterrupted applied path.

battleMove.description: A completed movement and its exact nonempty applied path as one tactical action. Rejected and zero-distance requests are absent. actor and side are omitted when unit carries the side prefix.

count.description: Creatures alive immediately after this hit.

topHp.description: Remaining hit points of the leading creature; absent when count is zero.

battleStackAfter.description: Frozen post-hit stack health. This makes the tactical fact independent of future damage and special-kill rules.

topHp.description: Hit points of the leading reborn creature.

battleRebirth.description: Explicit post-strike health when a lethal hit triggered rebirth.

hits.description: Ordered outcomes when a breath or area retaliation affects multiple stacks.

battleHit.description: One logical target of a breath, area, or other multi-target creature attack, including its frozen post-hit health.

battleAttackEffect.description: Secondary damage caused within an attack exchange, such as death stare or reflected fire-shield damage.

from.description: Exact cell occupied by the attacker when it struck. Siege arrow towers use VCMI's special upper-tower (-4), lower-tower (-3), and keep (-2) positions.

targetAt.description: Exact cell of the primary target when struck.

via.description: Exact traversed cells before from; absent when no pre-attack movement occurred.

returnPath.description: Automatic post-attack return path when more than one hex is material.

strikes.description: Number of deterministic strikes summarized by the aggregate damage and killed totals.

hits.description: Ordered logical outcomes for a single attack that affects multiple stacks.

applies.description: Named spell effects applied by a creature attack.

effects.description: Secondary deterministic damage folded into this attack exchange.

automatic.description: True when the battle engine selected this action automatically; replay observes it instead of submitting a duplicate decision.

battleAttack.description: The attack decision, approach path, single- or multi-target damage, and immediate retaliation in one action. killed is absent when zero.

temporary.description: Whether the created stack disappears with the battle instead of joining the strategic army.

battleCreation.description: A stack created by this cast, with its frozen identity, size, and cell. This keeps summons and clones readable while making replay independent of future spell formulas.

artifactSlotName.description: Human artifact slot name used in artifact@slot shorthand. Backpack slots are one-based.

artifactRef.description: Artifact with its final placement, for example stillEyeOfTheDragon@leftRing.

battleSpoilItem.description: One artifact gained from battle cleanup. Spell scrolls use the object form to preserve the scroll spell.

battleSpoils.description: Battle loot transferred to the winner. The loser/source is implied by the battle outcome; every artifact records only its final readable slot.

hits.description: Ordered frozen outcomes when a chain or area spell affects multiple stacks.

healed.description: Total hit points restored by this cast.

creates.description: Exact temporary or permanent stacks created by the cast. Ordinary implementation packets for adding and positioning them are omitted.

battleCast.description: One cast with deterministic notifications, status changes, mana cost, damage, healing, and created stacks folded into it. Creature casters carry their side in their alias; hero casts retain side.

count.description: Total surviving creatures in the healed stack.

topHp.description: Hit points of the partially damaged leading creature.

battleHeal.description: Automatic healing (normally a First Aid Tent action) with a readable amount and frozen post-heal health. This replaces raw spellCast and unitsChanged implementation packets.

battleBonusEffect.description: A battle-local bonus; the enclosing battle supplies its target, so no battle number is repeated.

survivors.description: Permanent surviving count by human-readable battle unit name. Dead units are omitted.

createdUnits.description: Permanent units created during combat. Count is the initially created amount; survivors holds the remaining amount.

beforeContinuation.description: Participant RNG checkpoint after tactics and before strategic battle-result processing.

atContinuation.description: Complete participant RNG checkpoint after generated strategic aftermath. Omitted when identical to beforeContinuation.

mana.description: Net persistent hero mana changes caused by the battle; omitted when zero.

armies.description: Absolute post-battle state of every surviving strategic participant army. Nonzero stack experience is explicit; zero is the defined default.

battleOutcome.description: Required semantic result and persistent post-battle changes, including casualties, hero mana, rewards, and ordered cleanup when present. It remains explicit even when tactical events are replayed, so a future replay mode can skip uninteresting battle internals. Repeated resultAccepted/resultsApplied/ended packets are not format variants.

battleRound.description: Ordered tactical events grouped under the engine round they belong to.

id.description: Transcript-local monotonic battle index, stable across save/load boundaries and shared with the companion.

randomBefore.description: Optional tactical RNG state supplied by the battle companion after setup and before the first decision.

events.description: Optional tactical events supplied by the battle companion.

battleBlock.description: Standalone strategic battle boundary. Only the accepted, completed attempt is emitted; cancelled quick-combat attempts are transactional and leave no partial block. The optional tactical fields are merged from the companion by id for full battle replay.

typedObject.description: Payload shared by the statically named audit/effect record variants. The record key is the discriminator. Open fields are explicitly embedded domain JSON or fields whose type varies by the discriminated record.

actor.description: Actor responsible for a local-state event.

activity.description: Semantic UI activity opened by an encounter, such as hero exchange or recruitment.

with.description: The other hero in an opened exchange activity.

result.description: Victory/loss, movement, or other enumerated outcome.

mode.description: Absolute/relative, learn/forget, or another operation mode selected by the record key.

object.description: Object alias, or null for a failed/null object creation.

id.description: Readable object alias or numeric runtime identifier, selected by the record kind.

movement.description: Movement points, or a list of per-hero new-turn movement values.

slot.description: Numeric army slot or named tavern/artifact slot.

erase.description: Artifact/stack erase operation, either boolean or structured.

battleRandomizerStreams.description: Participant-scoped biased random streams keyed by battle object ID. A zero-bias state is its generator integer; nonzero bias uses the explicit object form.

heroSkillRandomizerStates.description: Level-up randomizer states for the hero types participating in this battle.

nestedIntegerMap.description: Sparse entity-to-named-integers mapping. Signed values are changes; the enclosing set* record instead means absolute assignment.

creaturePool.description: Sparse creature-keyed available or growth pools. shared preserves one count shared by base/upgraded alternatives.

availabilityEffect.description: Initial recruitable pools grouped by semantic scope for the whole new-day chapter.

weeklyRewardsEffect.description: Realized weekly random rewards grouped by identical outcome. These frozen facts are never rerolled during replay.

spawnsEffect.description: Realized weekly wandering-monster spawns grouped by creature. Exact positions and counts are frozen stochastic facts.

newDayHeroRefreshes.description: Frozen absolute movement and mana changes generated for heroes at the start of this day, grouped first by player and then by hero. Replay uses these values instead of regenerating them, preserving the game across engine changes.

text.description: Genuine map-authored description only; generated localization metadata is omitted.

storyEffect.description: Custom map narrative; standard generated UI boilerplate is never a story record.

townlessEffect.description: A player's no-town defeat countdown. player is omitted inside that player's turn; cleared means the player regained a town.

turnEndEffect.description: Compact timer snapshots only; the endTurn decision already marks an ordinary boundary.

playerEndEffect.description: A player's terminal result. player is omitted inside that player's turn.

visibilityEffect.description: Exact fog delta compacted into inclusive horizontal x ranges. Player is omitted for the current turn actor and present only for a different player.

townEffect.description: Exceptional independent town mutation. Normal construction is the semantic build transaction and omits derived buildings.

player.description: New owner; omitted when it is the player named by the turn document.

questEffect.description: Quest progress for the current turn player; player is present only when different.

appearsEffect.description: Semantic appearance of a dynamically created map object; constructor details are regenerated by the action or map script.

revealEffect.description: A deterministic visibility change identified by its semantic cause; irregular authored masks remain visibility/runs.

discoversEffect.description: First strategic sightings caused by a displacement that is not represented as an ordinary move or teleport field. Observational assertion only: replay derives it and warns on disagreement.

levelUpEffect.description: Frozen game-changing level-up result. Replay corrects any regenerated primary roll and offered secondary skills before applying the recorded choice.

atomicRecord.description: One adventure action/effect record or one nested battle block. Unknown keys are rejected so an unmodelled format extension is visible to validators and generators.

heroScene.description: A bounded lexical scene for two or more consecutive actions by one hero. Nested actions omit hero; the context ends with the mapping.

record.description: A closed discriminated record. Unknown keys and fields are invalid.
